features.feature: Navigation, mobile task controls, focus and render stability
features.review_scope: Task navigation and controls are exercised in DOM; visual/touch/accessibility behavior needs rendered browser and device review.

features.feature: RF route, cable/passive interpolation, temperature, active gain, branches, drops
features.review_scope: Independent RF references plus route/DOM integration; not every model/frequency/configuration combination.

features.feature: TDR distance, velocity factor, boundary and active barriers
features.review_scope: Synthetic distance examples and active-boundary guards.

features.feature: Power circuit, curves, voltage drop, nonlinear load and what-if
features.review_scope: Independent numeric and invalid/convergence edge cases; installed load/waveform not physically measured.
Frequency limits, units, overrides and unknown launch exercised.

features.feature: Node identity, split limits, source selection and launch correction
features.review_scope: Standard GS7000 1G/1.2G and EN9000 selectable; SHO/Intelligent/RPD procedures not selectable setup claims.

features.feature: Equipment manuals, OEM AGC, DSIM and historical code lookup
features.review_scope: Exact model/control bindings, procedure selection, stale-context guards, source pages and pilot code tests; no physical DSIM controller/app connection.
Local 54/860 targets and 42 MHz TX reference separated from measured launch, pilot, injection and receive references; independent equations.
42 MHz forward/return sweepless distinct from 204/258 XPERTrak return; reference/compensation/acceptance guards; actual instrument capability and traces remain operator verification.

features.feature: Jobs, named copies, migration, imports/exports and training
features.review_scope: Working-job retention, cancellation, quota failures, portable recoveries and current/legacy migration fixtures.

features.feature: Evidence originals, CSV decoder, storage, hashes and context
features.review_scope: Original bytes preserved; native ONX/JSON/ZIP/PDF/XML/images are attachments, not a verified native schema decoder.
Content/dispatch/print restoration tested; actual OS file persistence, print pages and pagination unverified.

features.feature: Offline PWA installation, cache, update and retained work
features.review_scope: Service-worker network/cache lifecycle and install prompt simulations; actual Android/iOS lifecycle/offline eviction not proven.

gaps.area: Android APK / Android browser / iPhone Safari
gaps.finding: No physical Android SAF save/share/print callback, real iOS Files/share-sheet, native print pagination, real touch/night/sun layout, process-kill recovery, iOS storage eviction, offline launch/install/update evidence is established by these Node/DOM suites.
gaps.evidence: qa/browser-files.test.cjs uses navigator/bridge doubles; evidence tests use fake IndexedDB; qa/pwa-test-results.json explicitly limits scope.
gaps.next_verification: Device matrix for APK, Android Chrome and iPhone Safari with import/export originals, named-job retention and offline update.

gaps.finding: Inspected tests inject put/autosave/quota/owner failures, but no dedicated openDB blocked/open error/versionchange or getFile/cleanup transaction-abort injection was located. This is a branch-testing gap, not a confirmed defect or absent public-method coverage.
gaps.next_verification: Bounded IDB failure-injection tests and real browser recovery checks.

gaps.finding: Save/open/duplicate/delete/new/import/cancellation/quota/busy/reference-cleanup workflows are tested. No dedicated corrupt-library-entry or 1000-job ceiling injection test was located in the inspected suites. This is not evidence of a failing public method.
gaps.next_verification: Test malformed named-library entries and the 1000-to-1001 boundary without replacing the working job.

gaps.finding: No runtime V8/Istanbul branch/function coverage report or instrumented all-public-function invocation ledger is present. Passing 819 grouped checks does not prove every named function, callback, branch or equipment combination executed. Regex inventory misses anonymous callbacks, object method shorthand and secondary comma-bound arrows and can include text matches.
gaps.next_verification: Instrumented coverage in a separate QA task; review critical uncovered branches from that evidence.

gaps.finding: Actual receiver/transmitter/RPD/firmware/service plan/pilot suitability, local targets and measurement planes still require installed configuration verification. EN9000 portal commissioning text is unavailable; public briefs are capability references.
gaps.next_verification: Exact installed manuals/operator procedure plus physical measurements; never substitute generic or analog-return examples.

review_notes: No new tests were run by this report; 38/819 evidence is from the completed matching frozen-build report.
All 22 night-sweep JavaScript source texts are embedded unchanged in that tested standalone; the additional two files are PWA client/worker source templates.
Independent bounded review of browser export/evidence/jobs/reports/navigation found no product defect; direct call absence is not treated as absence of workflow coverage.
No executable function/branch coverage percentage is claimed.
